# Task: PR #7278 (#7182 PR-B family 2) — update the consumer tests your board/comms.v1 shape change broke; run the full fleet_comms suite (epic #7177).

Evidence rule (#M-4): back every claim with a command you ran. Commit on the attached branch `cursor/monitor-7182-burndown-family2`
(no push credentials — main pushes). Ruff on every changed .py. Before finishing run, with `FLEET_COMMS_ALLOW_LOCAL_SHADOW=1` exported
(this machine's local comms plane is retired; the env enables the isolated fixture): `tests/fleet_comms` IN FULL, `tests/test_fleet_comms_cli.py`,
`tests/test_fleet_observer_api.py`, `tests/test_comms_plane_status_api.py`, `tests/test_fleet_comms_legacy_broker_report.py`, the sweep serial
+ `-n 4 --basetemp=/tmp/<x>`, the three repo-wide guards, and the exact PR-tier selection:

## What main found in a full detached checkout at 847d222de5 (CI's fastlane does not select these modules)
- `tests/fleet_comms/test_efficiency_metrics_authority.py::test_backlog_defaults_authority_when_plane_authority` and
  `::test_backlog_legacy_flag_forces_broker` → `KeyError: 'db_path'` — the backlog/efficiency consumer tests still read the removed field.
- With the fixture env, `tests/fleet_comms/test_cold_start_board.py`: 18 passed, 1 failed → `test_size_cap` (assert on payload size —
  your `store` descriptors / `response_schema_version` changed the board's serialized size; decide whether the cap or the payload is wrong
  and say why; do not just raise the number without reasoning).
Your report claimed the changed suites passed; you ran only the tests you added. The merge-group full run would have rejected this.

## Outcome
Every consumer test reads the new `store` descriptors (never re-add `db_path`); `test_size_cap` fixed at its root; `tests/fleet_comms`
fully green under the fixture env. No producer changes unless a test exposes a real producer bug — then fix the producer and say so.

## Report
Commit SHA, every suite line above, the selector's module list, and `git status -sb`.

## Research registry classification
Consumer-test update — no research dimension; pointer-free by deliberate classification.

## ALSO — BLOCKER from the Codex r2 review (must close in this same delta)
`scripts/fleet_comms/cli.py:266-282` `bottleneck-metrics` still emits filesystem paths (`tasks_dir`, `plane_db`), omits `store` /
`response_schema_version`, and its `source_errors` (built in `scripts/fleet_comms/efficiency_metrics.py:610-650`) can contain full paths.
Descriptorize the output via `opsec_store.py` (`tasks_store`, `plane_store`), make `source_errors` carry an error kind + store descriptor
(never a path string), bump `response_schema_version`, and add mutation coverage (re-adding `tasks_dir` → a named test fails).
